name: Graveyard counts: whose graveyard and which cards (Knight of the Reliquary, Magnivore, Desmond Miles, Katara, Cognivore, Terravore, Cid)
notes: The isGraveyardCount branch counted every player's graveyard and filtered only on 'creature'. P1's graveyard: Forest, Bolt, Divination, Introduction to Prophecy (Lesson), Royal Assassin, Etherium Sculptor, Changeling Outcast (every creature type), Malakir Rebirth // Malakir Mire (an instant, no land card). Opponent's: Wasteland, Bolt, Royal Assassin, Divination. Knight counts Forest, the opponent's Multani Wasteland; Desmond the Assassin and the changeling; Katara the Lesson; Cognivore three instants, Magnivore three sorceries, Terravore two lands; Ornithopter gets Cid plus two Artificer cards; Xande four noncreature, nonland cards; Umbra Stalker four black symbols; Wight of Precinct Six and Detritivore only the opponent's creature and nonbasic land card. Memory: project_graveyard_counts_by_owner_and_kind_2026-11-22.
